extracted.name: Easy Homemade Taco Seasoning Mix
extracted.description: What's in taco seasoning exactly? Toss several spices together and find out with this easy recipe to make your own. A great alternative to packets.
instruction_lines: Mix onion powder, chili powder, cumin, paprika, garlic powder, oregano, sugar, and salt together in a small bowl.
